evidence.supportingExcerpt: In a tumour, a tumour-associated macrophage is named for its location, and its state and tested functions are separate questions. A tumour can hold several programmes in different neighbourhoods or at different times. An expression cluster can suggest a repair, interferon or lipid-handling programme, which is a hypothesis; it does not establish that the cells suppress T cells, kill cancer cells or would respond to a macrophage-directed drug.
